title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 259 Nassau Street, Suite 2 in Princeton, New Jersey, as the "Dr. John F. Nash, Jr. Post Office".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 259 Nassau Street, Suite 2 in Princeton, New Jersey, as the "Dr. John F. Nash, Jr. Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named a Princeton, New Jersey post office after mathematician John F. Nash Jr.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 259 Nassau Street, Suite 2 in Princeton, New Jersey, as the "Dr. John F. Nash, Jr. Post Office." It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 23, 2018.
